Finite-support coordinate perturbations prove ‖φ‖=‖a‖1+‖s‖; hence J**φ=(a_n) and ‖J**φ‖∞=‖a‖∞. For unit near-attainers ‖s‖<δ. Conversely for any σ=‖s‖<δ, all s+(1−σ)θe_n are sphere near-attainers; their norm-closed convex hull contains s+(1−σ)Bℓ1. Approximate σ=δ by (1−1/k)s. This proves exact Cδ and distance by contracting the singular component; a singular norm-one functional exists by Hahn–Banach on ℓ∞/c0, giving failure of all r-generating radii.
